paragraphs: Chapter 956
Episode 235. Zito (5)
Even in that moment, Zito was causing Jin pain through his contact with Elona.
He was trying to create even the tiniest opening. If the sun splitter unleashed in its entirety, Zito wouldn't be able to escape unscathed.
'Damn, I might've been better off fighting someone like Ayulra. This kind of power is beyond most immortals.'
Zito knew better than anyone that the entire underworld was briefly dyed in Jin's golden aura.
Filling the entire land of agony with a different power instead of mana. As far as Zito knew, the number of immortals who could do that after the Sun God didn't exceed three.
'I did think Jin Runcandel would have a way to fight me… but to this extent? What is this? Did the witch really allow a mortal to have this kind of power?'
But now wasn't the time to be shocked.
A vast golden swamp that could easily swallow a god was opening. To survive and escape the swamp, he had to bring out all the measures and techniques he'd saved up.
'It's a shame, but you're done, Jin Runcandel. I need to save Orugal and think about the future.'
Zito's form quickly became clear.
At the same time, his surrounding magic exploded, pushing back the golden aura. He was targeting Elona before Jin.
In order to unleash this kind of sword, he assumed that the 'resonance' between Jin and Elona sharing the pain would have surely been dissolved.
"Kuh!"
As Zito predicted, Elona immediately recoiled from the mental attack. Zito was planning to use Elona as a hostage to delay Jin's attack for a moment.
However, Elona had just regained the memories of her most radiant time. The dark past surfacing from the mental attack couldn't shake Elona as much as before, thanks to those memories.
The ground where Elona stood exploded and sank under Zito's punch. Elona safely dodged to Jin's back.
As soon as she lifted her head and looked forward, Elona sighed inwardly, forgetting the immediate pain.
A huge golden ring was wrapping around Zito. Zito was floundering to get out of the ring, and each time, a purple shockwave spread out from the ring, causing a loud noise.
Then, as Jin recalled his sword and swung again at Zito, another identical ring was formed.
Thus, a total of four rings tied up Zito. The rings crossed each other and completely blocked Zito's surroundings.
Sometimes, an arm or a leg would protrude from the ring. Each time, the golden energy radiating nearby would swarm in and gnaw at the protruding flesh of Jito.
'This is... different from the Solar Divider that Temar used.'
Elrona remembered the sight of him using the Solar Divider. The sword that Jin unfolded now was the same only in attribute, the form was completely different from Temar's sword.
Jin did not directly inherit the Solar Divider from him. It had to be different because he was trying to recreate the sword he glimpsed in the world within Kaitam's painting.
However, in Elrona's view, Jin's sword now did not fall short of Temar's.
Rather, it felt even more stable. In fact, Jito was still struggling because he couldn't escape from the ring.
"Huff...!"
Jin drew his sword with a rough breath. Sweat and blood were evaporating without rest from his body, hot like lava.
"It was a bit precarious."
"The power to slay him?"
"Yes. I managed to successfully suppress him without losing him, but it seems I've used up a lot of stamina."
"It's because of me."

"That's a wrong thought. If you hadn't been here, it wouldn't have been easy to seize this opportunity in the first place. The fact that I could use this sword by sharing some of the pain, one could say the price is rather cheap."
Jin made eye contact with Elrona.
"I am going to pour all my will into slaying him from now on. I guess it will be the longest slash since I've held a sword."
The Solar Divider unfolded by Temar in his heyday a thousand years ago was close to an extreme swift sword in form.
Jin initially followed that method to slay Jito. However, facing Jito's monstrous reality in actual combat, he realized that Jito was not a being that could be slain in an instant.

Just like when Shirone landed a heavy blow on him when he returned to the Garden of Swords in the past, he decided that it would be appropriate to use an extremely heavy blunt sword. That's why he formed the ring that was not in Kaitam's painting on purpose.
"Do you mean that I should handle all the variables that occur in the meantime?"
Jin nodded.
"Correct, Elrona Ziph. We seem to understand each other quite well."
"Right now, I feel like I've met an old friend. After we take down that dark monster together, as promised, I'll face the past."
"That's good to hear. It seems you still have some memories popping up."
"Memories of the only time I didn't hate myself. I believe you would prevent our family from having experiences like mine."
Elona extended her fist to Jin. Jin, grinning faintly, bumped his fist lightly against hers.
[Krrrrrr, Kaahhhhh!]

Jito's struggles continued to intensify. However, the ring that bound him remained solidly fixed and didn't budge an inch. Only shockwaves escaped from the ring, causing explosions here and there on the battlefield.
Jin remained silent, focusing his mind again.
Now, all he could see was Jito. His spirit was filled without remainder with the will to slash Jito, and his body seemed to exist solely to kill Jito.
At this point, Jin could easily be killed by an ordinary human. His physical and mental state, focused solely on Jito, had no resistance to other external attacks.
Now it was time for Elona to protect Jin.
Although her head felt like it would explode every time she unavoidably came into contact with Jito's energy, Elona clutched her staff.
[Khh... Do you think this is the end for me?]
Jito shouted, grasping the ring that surrounded the center.
Jin was now moving his sword. The blade, descending like a slowly sinking glacier, made no sound of cutting through air.
A light flowing infinitely slow.
Jito looked up at the light formed in front of his eyes, following the path of the sword.
He had no choice but to receive it. Or he had to topple Jin before the light touched him, to prevent him from completing the Sun Splitter.
[Kaaak!]
Jito began to push away the ring he was holding. The two hands that held the ring continuously disintegrated and regenerated, whirling purple ash.
Bit by bit, the ring was moving. It seemed to require too much time to open wide enough for Jito to escape. Jin's sword would reach Jito's head first within that ring.
But Jito's goal was not to get out of the ring.
'It's done!'

He intended to open the sky of the abyss, which was tightly closed again. He had been wary of opening the abyss until now, but this time he had to use it. Jito reached his arm beyond the twisted gap of the ring.
Woosh-! As soon as he clenched his fist, the sky distorted and the abyss was exposed again.
Jito thrust his arm hideously into it. The moment his arm entered the abyss, even Jito screamed in pain. It was a painful scream that didn't match his previous declarations of pain as pleasure.
[Kheuak, cough...!]
For a while, Jito seemed to be looking for something there, like a person rummaging through a box.
Elona released her magic toward Jito's arm, but with her current resolve, she couldn't inflict a significant blow on Jito.
Even so, she couldn't amplify her magic power to increase the destructive force. If she did, it could potentially interfere with Jin's sword.
'It seems like he's trying to take something out... What is that!?'
Zito's arm was emerging again from the abyss.
In his hand, there was a sphere emitting a pale light. Although the size was small, Elona's eyes widened as she felt the power contained in the sphere.
Artificial Sun.
It was like the heart of the Demon Realm, crossing the abyss, resting in the palm of Zito's hand. It was Zito's last resort.
"Heh, Jin Runcandel. It was really dangerous this time... but when this explodes, it's game over for both of you."
Without a moment's hesitation, Zito clenched his fist.
Simultaneously, his arm scattered into particles and the light spread in all directions, and Jin's circle holding Zito became a protective shield instead.
Most of the power of the artificial sun was exploding towards Jin and Elona. Zito used the circle to withstand the explosion, smirking.

When Jin unfolded the Sun Splitter, golden energy briefly illuminated the entire Demon Realm, this time darkness descended on the Demon Realm. Since the sun was destroyed, there couldn't be any light in the Demon Realm for a while.
"I only need Orgal Remirias anyway! I nearly destroyed myself being greedy. I'm sick of it. Goodbye, Jin!"
Jin gritted his teeth listening to Zito's distant voice mixed with the explosion.
However, it wasn't because he was dizzy from the unexpected shock, or because he thought he couldn't complete the Sun Splitter.
On the contrary, the victory seemed more certain. All he had to do was not lose his sword.
"I was really nervous, so you're saying this was the last variable?"
While blocking the explosion connected to Jin's front with her magic, Elona said.
From Zito's point of view, it was incomprehensible.
He expected Elona to block some of the explosion of the artificial sun, but he didn't expect her to handle it so easily.
Thanks to her perfectly blocking the explosion, Jin was able to swing his sword without any impact. The blade was now approaching Zito's eyes.
"How are you blocking this... isn't it hard?"

"It's not a task that requires willpower. Unlike eradicating transcendent beings like you, just blocking a powerful force... Let's just say it has its uses for me. The power I have exists for such moments, for such people. I've forgotten that fact for too long."
Whooosh...!
As Elona swung her staff, the force of the exploded artificial sun began to split left and right, opening a path.
Jin was completing the path of his sword following that path.
